"""Development-only geometry sweep; runs exclusively inside a Slurm allocation."""
import os,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=Path(sys.argv[1]);OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
assert os.environ.get('SLURM_JOB_ID'), 'Slurm allocation required'
SEEDS=list(range(1001,1031));SCENARIOS=['francis2023_pedestrian_overtaking','classic_station_platform_medium','francis2023_robot_crowding']
print('RESOLVED SEEDS',SEEDS,flush=True)
assert all(1001<=s<=1030 for s in SEEDS)
def run(cell):
 name,seed,arm=cell
 from robot_sf.training.scenario_loader import load_scenarios
 from robot_sf.benchmark.map_runner.map_runner import _run_map_episode
 import yaml
 p=ROOT/'configs/scenarios/classic_interactions_francis2023_release_0_0_8_v1.yaml'
 sc=dict(next(s for s in load_scenarios(p) if s['name']==name));sc['seeds']=[seed];sc['map_file']=str((p.parent/sc['map_file']).resolve())
 cfg=ROOT/f'configs/algos/{arm}_release_v0_0_8.yaml';ac=yaml.safe_load(cfg.read_text()) if arm!='goal' else {}
 # Same runner; use exact-base scenario-authored budget (overtaking 400 steps). No campaign seed-set resolution.
 ep=_run_map_episode(sc,seed,horizon=None,dt=.1,record_forces=True,snqi_weights=None,snqi_baseline=None,algo=arm,scenario_path=p,algo_config=ac,algo_config_path=str(cfg) if arm!='goal' else None,record_simulation_step_trace=True)
 f=OUT/f'{name}__{arm}__{seed}.json';f.write_text(json.dumps(ep,default=str));return [name,arm,seed,ep.get('termination_reason'),ep.get('steps'),hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()]
if __name__=='__main__':
 import robot_sf,pysocialforce
 head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
 physics=Path(pysocialforce.__file__).parent;tracked=ROOT/'fast-pysf/pysocialforce'
 files={str(p.relative_to(tracked)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in tracked.rglob('*.py')}
 assert all((physics/f).read_bytes()==(tracked/f).read_bytes() for f in files),'stale pysocialforce'
 (OUT/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'head':head,'seeds':SEEDS,'scenarios':SCENARIOS,'planners':['risk_dwa','goal','social_force'],'job':os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID'],'node':os.environ.get('SLURMD_NODENAME'),'python':sys.version,'physics':files,'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
 cells=[(n,s,a) for n in SCENARIOS for a in ['risk_dwa','goal','social_force'] for s in SEEDS]
 with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=int(os.environ['SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK'])-1) as pool:
  for result in pool.map(run,cells):
   with (OUT/'summary.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
   print(json.dumps(result[:5]),flush=True)
 (OUT/'DONE').write_text(f'{head} {len(cells)}\n')
